problem_statement:
mvcc: rename RangeOptions.Count to CountOnly

Align the server-side `mvcc.RangeOptions` field name with the client's `CountOnly` naming (client/v3 `WithCountOnly`/`IsCountOnly`, and the `RangeRequest.CountOnly` proto field). No behavior change.

This also removes the awkward `Count: r.CountOnly` mapping in `server/etcdserver/txn/range.go`.

Requested by @serathius in https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/pull/21618.

Rename putResponse to txnReponse as it doesn't specify put and is also used for delete

/cc @nwnt

Client: Rename etcdClientDebugLevel function to the ClientLogLevel

Please read https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contribution-flow.

This PR allows to external projects to utilize this function during custom logger creation to align functionality with internal ETCD client logic.
Fox example Kubernetes copy/paste this function about 2 years ago, but now it's not up to date. It's better to import it and have up to date always.
Also Cluster API requires this function too.
